The '''blister blaster''' was a high-velocity [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. It fired hollow ammunition containing a volatile [[petro-chemical reactant]] that when exposed to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] upon impact ignited in a small area around the target.
